While the HTF trend remains strongly bullish, lower-timeframe (M5) Momentum Indicators (Stochastic and CCI) will reach oversold conditions precisely as price taps our defensive staff zone, triggering a sharp, preemptive wick-rejection and immediate upside continuation.
